Tiger Financial's subsidiary Vietpay achieves PCI DSS Level 1 Security Certification, the highest security validation for payment service providers, laying the groundwork for expansion into Southeast Asian markets.
Proof of Management’s Industry Experience and Methodical Execution of Growth Plans.
Vancouver, BC and San Juan, Puerto Rico – TheNewswire - November 23, 2026 - Tiger Financial Services Inc.,

(“Tiger” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that its wholly owned subsidiary, Vietpay Technology Co., Ltd. (“Vietpay”), has achieved independently validated compliance with the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) version 4.0.1 as a Level 1 Service Provider. This milestone strengthens the Company’s foundation for pursuing bank partnerships and expanding across Southeast Asia.

PCI DSS is a globally recognized security standard for organizations that store, process or transmit payment card data. Level 1 service provider validation requires an annual assessment by an independent Qualified Security Assessor, documented in a Report on Compliance. The assessment evaluates compliance with rigorous technical and operational requirements designed to protect cardholder data, as outlined on the PCI Security Standards Council’s website: https://www.pcisecuritystandards.org. Achieving this level of security validation requires months of rigorous testing and substantial investment in data center infrastructure, IT platforms, cybersecurity software, and a highly experienced team of security engineers and operations personnel.

The assessment covers shared payment infrastructure which supports both Tiger’s platform in Vietnam, as well as its regional platform expected to begin supporting further operations in Southeast Asia. The Level 1 certification provides prospective regional bank partners with an independent and internationally recognized validation of Tiger’s security controls and technical abilities.

By building on its existing infrastructure and operating experience, management aims to establish a repeatable approach to entering new markets. PCI DSS provides a common global security framework, while each deployment would be adapted to local regulatory requirements, partner bank specifications and the applicable assessment scope.

Management is currently engaged in active commercial and technical discussions with regional banks operating in other Southeast Asian markets. This security validation addresses an important component of bank partnership discussions and security due diligence, strengthening the foundation for integrating Tiger’s platform with partner banks across the region. Proposed integrations would connect partner banks’ systems with Tiger’s e-commerce payment gateway, POS switches, mobile banking platform and corporate card services; subject to definitive agreements, bank approvals and applicable regulatory requirements.

This milestone reflects the disciplined approach management has applied across prior fintech ventures: build the infrastructure, validate it independently, establish operational maturity, partner with licensed commercial banks, then scale market by market.

“Achieving PCI DSS Level 1 validation is an important step in advancing our bank partnership strategy,” said Ben Aissa, CEO and Chairman of Tiger Financial. “It gives prospective partners independent evidence of our payment security controls and supports our ongoing discussions on commercial terms and technical integration.”

He added: “Our approach is disciplined and practical. Our objective is to build on the technology, security infrastructure and operational expertise which we have accrued. We built the foundation in Vietnam, and from there we plan to replicate across further Southeast Asian bank partnerships."
About Tiger Financial Services Inc.

Tiger is an international fintech focused on high-growth emerging markets. Headquartered in Puerto Rico, the company develops and launches AI-powered banking infrastructure for small businesses across Southeast Asia. Led by founder and CEO Ben Aissa, a fintech entrepreneur with over 20 years of international experience scaling payments and banking ventures, Tiger combines AI-driven payments, digital banking, and embedded finance to serve one of the world's largest underserved business segments. Through its Vietnam subsidiary, Vietpay Technology Company Corporation, Tiger has an operating foothold in Southeast Asia and plans to expand across Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Cambodia, and Myanmar, a regional opportunity of more than 60 million small businesses. Tiger's model combines proprietary technology with deep market expansion expertise and partnerships with licensed commercial banks, enabling the company to deliver tailored local fintech services in full compliance with regulators while executing a multi-country high-growth strategy.
